# Spec Ledger independent adversarial/source review

2026-11-03, agent:runtime-repo-docs. Reviewed source checkpoint 651b9a59a83ffd4d83e4f18767e240d120c155fa. First reader task answers are separately recorded in spec-reader-round1.md. No product edits or formal ledger review yet; parent owns final tree and turn.

Sampled CLI main/client verifier, application receipts/operations, read verifier, execution policies and workflow snapshots/version updates. Claims match these owners: CLI verify invokes a command-running operation; request start receipts precede effects and uncertain requests refuse rerun; stale source/check/artifacts prevent current pass; adopted methods are immutable snapshots; continuation and timeout enforcement do not manufacture host capabilities.

All three finite models and seven mutation definitions inspected. EvidenceFreshness intentionally checks evaluation-time matching, not asynchronous hash/storage integrity. MutationRetry treats one serialized request and abstracts filesystem locks, with no atomic-effect or general repair guarantee. WorkflowCopy checks adopted snapshot stability and expected-version admission, without filesystem race coverage. Separate expected/current/captured state avoids defining invariants solely as their admission condition. Every listed invariant has a meaningful guard-bypass or effect mutation. No unresolved material model/source finding in this scope.

Independent execution used a copied docs/scripts/control fixture, preserving author receipts and production code. Command: NESSA_DOCS_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/work/nessa-docs node work/doc-quality/spec-breaker-fixture/scripts/state-docs/verify.mjs. Actual Node runtime and absolute root are recorded in local command receipts. Output spec-breaker-models.log: three baselines passed, seven controls failed their intended semantic rules; final {"ok":true,"documents":20,"models":3,"controls":7}. Independent states 39 aggregate.

One out-of-intent killer: malformed catalog with duplicate root/claim identity, using only a temporary fixture. Actual runner exited 1 with duplicate-id and missing-parent errors before producing baseline output; existing results.json SHA-256 unchanged. Evidence spec-breaker-invalid-catalog.json records exact command/exit/output and checks. It fails for the intended rejected-input reason, not because the checker was unavailable. This tests a runner boundary beyond the six task journeys; no source fix needed. Hunt stops here.

Final review must await frozen tree and finished verification prose. Existing build/tests/browser and ledger completeness are author-owned evidence, not independently rerun by this reviewer. Passing these finite models does not execute TypeScript or establish production security.

Final frozen verification page re-read: separates existing353tests and historical35claim run from current model/browser evidence; no new material finding. Review scopes atlas/docsrunner only. Retained control identities: verification/state-models/controls.json; author baseline/control receipts: results.json. Independent execution: NESSA_DOCS_ROOT=/Users/nessa/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/hey-can-you-update-the-nessa/work/nessa-docs /Users/nessa/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node work/doc-quality/spec-breaker-fixture/scripts/state-docs/verify.mjs. Extra duplicate-root fixture: exit1 duplicate-id(sl-claims twice), missing-parent; existing results SHA-256 unchanged; no baseline output. Breaker modified only isolated fixtures and review. No product fix, no sealed deviation. No whole-product correctness claim.
